notice: Menu paths vary by vendor (Apple, Google, Microsoft, Samsung). Use the search bar in your device Settings if a menu differs.

warningCloudSync.title: Two-Way Cloud Sync Hazard
warningCloudSync.summary: Never manually drag files to Trash while signed into iCloud, Google Drive, or OneDrive.
warningCloudSync.detail: Two-way sync mirrors local deletions across all connected devices. Sign out of accounts first or execute a Factory Data Reset to sanitize local hardware without touching cloud backups.

checklistSteps.title: Backing Up Important Files
checklistSteps.summary: Copy essential files and 2FA recovery codes to encrypted external media or cloud.
actionItems: Copy documents and photos to an encrypted USB drive or cloud vault.
Verify backup integrity on a secondary machine before proceeding.
Export 2FA authenticator apps (Google / Microsoft Authenticator) to your primary phone.
Export browser bookmarks and password vault credentials.

osSpecificTips.apple: iOS: Settings > [Name] > iCloud Backup. Mac: Run Time Machine to external drive.
osSpecificTips.android: Settings > Google > Backup: Confirm photos and contacts are synced.
osSpecificTips.windows: Settings > Accounts > Windows Backup, or copy 'C:\Users\[User]' to external drive.

checklistSteps.title: Signing Out of Accounts
checklistSteps.summary: Deauthorize ecosystem accounts, store licenses, and messaging sessions.
actionItems: Sign out of your primary Apple ID, Google Account, or Microsoft Account.
Deauthorize application licenses (Adobe CC, Microsoft 365, Steam).
Log out of web browsers and purge local synced autofill and passwords.
Sign out of messaging apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord) and revoke active sessions.

osSpecificTips.apple: iOS: Settings > [Name] > Sign Out. Mac: System Settings > Apple ID > Sign Out.
osSpecificTips.android: Settings > Passwords & Accounts: Tap each account and tap 'Remove Account'.
osSpecificTips.windows: Settings > Accounts > Access work or school: Remove organizational logins.

checklistSteps.title: Removing SIM and Memory Cards
checklistSteps.summary: Eject physical SIM trays, memory expansion cards, and erase eSIMs.
actionItems: Use a SIM pin or paperclip to eject cellular card trays.
Remove physical Nano/Micro-SIM cards to prevent billing or identity leaks.
Remove MicroSD storage cards from trays or battery compartments.
Select 'Erase eSIM' during the factory reset prompt if using virtual SIMs.

osSpecificTips.apple: iPhone: Select 'Delete eSIM' when prompted during the reset sequence.
osSpecificTips.android: Unmount adoptable MicroSD cards in Storage Settings before physical removal.
osSpecificTips.windows: Check laptop side expansion slots for camera SD cards.

checklistSteps.title: Disabling Device-Tracking Locks When Transferring Ownership
checklistSteps.summary: Decouple anti-theft locks to prevent hardware bricking upon reset.
actionItems: Turn off Apple Activation Lock ('Find My') before initiating reset.
Remove Google Account in Settings to prevent Factory Reset Protection (FRP) lockout.
Unenroll Chromebooks from enterprise or school Google Workspace domains.
Clear BIOS supervisor passwords and decrypt BitLocker drives.

osSpecificTips.apple: Verify at iCloud.com/find that the device is removed from your account.
osSpecificTips.android: FRP bricks phones if reset via recovery buttons without prior account removal.
osSpecificTips.windows: Run `manage-bde -status` in PowerShell to confirm BitLocker decryption.

checklistSteps.title: Factory Resetting the Device
checklistSteps.summary: Execute built-in factory reset to incinerate master cryptographic keys.
actionItems: Connect device to AC wall power to prevent shutdown during wipe sequence.
Select 'Erase All Content and Settings' or 'Fully clean the drive'.
Factory reset destroys master encryption keys, rendering NAND blocks unreadable.
For legacy mechanical hard drives (HDDs), perform multi-pass NIST 800-88 sanitization.

osSpecificTips.apple: iOS/macOS: Settings > General > Transfer or Reset > Erase All Content and Settings.
osSpecificTips.android: Settings > System > Reset Options > Erase all data (factory reset).
osSpecificTips.windows: Settings > System > Recovery > Reset this PC > Remove everything > Clean drive.

checklistSteps.title: Checking Removable Storage & Peripherals
checklistSteps.summary: Inspect USB ports, optical trays, and expansion bays for forgotten accessories.
actionItems: Unplug 2.4GHz wireless mouse and keyboard nano USB receivers.
Eject optical disc drives (CD/DVD/Blu-ray) using the emergency pinhole latch.
Check camera card reader slots and external backup drives.
Ensure secondary internal storage drives on desktops are sanitized or pulled.

osSpecificTips.apple: Check rear Thunderbolt/USB ports on iMac, Mac mini, or Studio.
osSpecificTips.android: Check USB-C port for magnetic breakaway charging dongles.
osSpecificTips.windows: Confirm secondary internal SATA/NVMe storage drives are wiped.

checklistSteps.title: Separating Account Removal from File Deletion
checklistSteps.summary: Decouple cloud syncing before performing local storage sanitization.
actionItems: Manual file trashing in synced folders deletes cloud backups everywhere.
Unlink OneDrive, Google Drive, or Dropbox apps before cleaning files.
Verify personal files exist on cloud web portals via another computer.
Trigger Factory Reset to wipe local sectors without issuing cloud deletion commands.

osSpecificTips.apple: When signing out of iCloud on Mac, choose NOT to keep local copies.
osSpecificTips.android: Never bulk-delete photos in Google Photos; remove the Google Account instead.
osSpecificTips.windows: Right-click OneDrive in taskbar > Settings > Account > 'Unlink this PC'.

checklistSteps.title: Confirming That the Next Owner Cannot Access Personal Information
checklistSteps.summary: Verify the initial out-of-the-box setup screen with zero login prompts.
actionItems: Reboot device after reset sequence finishes.
Confirm screen displays initial 'Hello' or 'Select Region' welcome screen.
Do NOT enter Wi-Fi credentials or configure a user profile.
Hold physical power button down to shut off cleanly for handover.

osSpecificTips.apple: Confirm screen displays multi-language 'Hello' without Apple ID prompts.
osSpecificTips.android: Verify phone boots to 'Welcome' screen without requesting prior PIN.
osSpecificTips.windows: Confirm boot to initial Windows out-of-box setup, then power down.
